dslRule:
<!id: enum.unqualified.constant.switchcase>
<!description: Replace qualified enum constant with unqualified constant in switch-case labels, where it is typically a compiler error (e.g., EnumClass.CONSTANT becomes CONSTANT).>
<!severity: ERROR>
$qualifier.$constant :: parentMatches("case $labelExpression:") && subtypeOf($qualifier, "java.lang.Enum") && elementKindMatches($constant, "ENUM_CONSTANT")
=> $constant
;;
summary: Replaces qualified enum constants (e.g., `MyEnum.VALUE`) with their unqualified simple names (`VALUE`) when used as case labels in a switch statement, addressing a common compiler error.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
